title: Extend a nonconstant map to smooth proper curve completions
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $X,Y$ be smooth separated connected one-dimensional schemes of finite type over $k$ [def-sc-curves]. Let $u:X\to Y$ be a nonconstant $k$-morphism, meaning that its image is not a single point. Let $j_X:X\hookrightarrow\overline X$ and $j_Y:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ be dense open immersions into smooth proper connected curves over $k$, with finite closed complements [lem-sc-compactification]. There is a unique $k$-morphism $\overline u:\overline X\to\overline Y$ satisfying $\overline u j_X=j_Yu$. It is finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free]; in particular it is finite and flat, including when the induced function-field extension is inseparable.

source.place: Tags 0BXZ (lemma-extend-over-normal-curve), 0CCK (lemma-flat), and 0CCL (lemma-finite); the extension used in SGA4 XVIII proof of Lemma 1.1.5, printed p. 488.
